scope: Static character/artwork motion only; no original runtime access, target execution, or WASM decompilation.

findings.claim: Dot SVG is only static body/eye geometry. The saved interactive character route is mec → J9s → B9s → iframe frame.mjs → presentation.mjs → orbit WASM engine. Legacy SVG, sprite pets, rendered snapshots and interactive characters are distinct paths; which the original account currently uses remains unknown.
findings.gap: DotAvatar is a single static img and ignores avatar type. Adding a CSS bounce would not recreate this renderer.

findings.claim: Host t7s maps paused→Paused; attached failed turn→Error; ready or finished→Ready; activeFlags→NeedsInput; sleeping→Ready; status strings working/searching/creating/payment/needs input/paused→matching kind; unknown in-progress→Thinking. Local active computer use→Working, other active→Thinking. B9s converts None to Ready.
findings.gap: Current DotAvatar has no activity input or state-dependent appearance.

findings.claim: CharacterActivityController sends ordered Start/Stop episodes, ignores unchanged kind+turnId, suppresses activity while fitting, and always uses Neutral outcome because a status change does not prove success.

Avatar mode forwards only Move to setReadyGaze; legacy drag/reaction is disabled by activity binding. Host x9s rejects touch and begins a 10000ms attention window when cursor enters target; attention clears on timeout, blur or document hidden. Engine docs say gaze overlays continuing Ready clock and release eases back without restart.
findings.gap: Current img has no pointer gaze or attention clock.

findings.claim: Editor S9s distinguishes click from drag with 6px max movement; primary left-button pointer capture, coalesced drag events, cancellation on blur/hidden/lostcapture. Click/keyboard invokes Signature reaction if ready/active and not framing/editing. Editor after edit pauses gaze for300ms then smoothsteps from center to clamped pointer over200ms; reduced-motion immediate.
findings.gap: Current appearance editor lacks drag, click reaction, gaze easing.

findings.claim: Appearance picker uses startViewTransition between actual avatar and editor preview; scales source transform by source/destination dimensions, hides trigger while open, and can include surface/modal/backdrop. CSS duration300ms, cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); modal scale.9+opacity, surface translateX100%+opacity. Disabled when reduced motion, keyboard-triggered, unsupported variant or noninteractive character.
findings.gap: Current dialog showModal has no avatar shared-element transition.

findings.claim: Activity avatar is drawn in a double-sized outer frame (-inset-1/2) with inner frameScale.5, leaving room for reactions. Rendering gates on active/visibility, keeps polling reduced-motion so gaze/release can settle, retains neutral snapshot while engine prepares and during resize.

Sprite pet route is distinct: 192x208cells,8columns;v2 has11rows,16look directions at22.5degree intervals in rows9/10. Idle base times280/110/110/140/140/320ms multiplied6. Non-loop states play3times then idle. Hover jumping belongs to mascot pet route, not proven for interactive Dot.

unknowns: Exact Ready/Working/Searching/etc geometry, blink rhythm, easing and prop trajectories are implemented in WASM and have not been recovered.
Currently active original account avatar branch is unknown.
No frame/pixel comparison or animation runtime observation was performed.
implementation_priority: Separate interactive character from legacy SVG/sprite/snapshot roles.
Add activity state contract and Ready gaze/attention independently from renderer geometry.
Reproduce shared-element appearance transition and input gesture thresholds.
Inspect engine static artifacts before claiming same character animation; do not replace unknowns with arbitrary bounce.
